o.text: From Proto-Turkic *teke/*tekä/*täkä. Cognate with Chuvash така (tak̬a, “male animal”).
Possibly from Proto-Common Turkic *sov- (“to turn of the road; to take aside; to cease”), whence also Azerbaijani sovulmaq and Azerbaijani sovuşmaq.
Borrowed from Russian метеорограф (meteorograf). By surface analysis, meteoro- + -qraf.
